newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HOT RECEPTION AWAITS SHERINGHAM AT SPURS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HOT RECEPTION AWAITS SHERINGHAM AT SPURS.

text.p: Champions Manchester United open their title defence this weekend with a mouth-watering clash at new-look Tottenham as the English premier league gets underway.
The Sunday fixture sees England striker Teddy Sheringham return to White Hart Lane for the first time since his close-season move to Old Trafford as replacement for the retired Eric Cantona.

Tottenham fans' fury at the sale of Sheringham has been swiftly eased by the acquisition of another England striker, Les Ferdinand, and French midfielder David Ginola -- both from Newcastle -- and they are expected to make their Spurs' debuts.
Gerry Francis's gain was certainly Kenny Dalglish's loss as the sale of Ferdinand, coupled with Alan Shearer's ligament injury, leaves Newcastle without an out-and-out striker.

Dalglish, looking for a morale boosting victory ahead of next week's Champions League qualifying match against Croatia Zagreb, will be without defender Darren Peacock when the Magpies entertain Sheffield Wednesday but former England skipper Stuart Pearce should make his debut.
Italian Paulo Di Canio, Wednesday's 4.5 million pounds ($7.2 million) signing from Celtic, will have to wait to make his premier league bow, though, as he is only 60-70 percent fit.
Liverpool kick off their season with a tricky visit to Wimbledon and will be without striker Robbie Fowler and his England team mate Jamie Redknapp who have knee and ankle injuries.
Patrik Berger, Bjorn Tore Kvarme and Oyvind Leonhardsen are also out injured but German Karl-Heinz Riedle could make his debut.

Leeds boss George Graham welcomes his former side Arsenal to Elland Road with striker Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink poised to make his premier league debut, while Arsenal could have Christopher Wreh, cousin of George Weah, on the bench after the Liberian striker signed from Monaco on Thursday.
Blackburn coach Roy Hodgson takes charge of his first league match at Ewood Park following his move from Inter Milan in the summer when Rovers entertain Derby.
Swedish star Martin Dahlin is set to make his debut but England squad goalkeeper Tim Sherwood is out with a groin injury.
Derby will miss forward Dean Sturridge after knee surgery and Croatian captain Aljosa Asanovic is doubtful with a hamstring injury.
Ruud Gullit's Chelsea open their premier league campaign with a visit to Coventry and Nigerian international Celestine Babayaro is lined up to make his first start for the F.A. Cup holders.
Norwegian striker Tore Andre Flo is also in the frame to play.

Barnsley's first-ever top-flight match in their 110-year history sees them entertain West Ham at Oakwell. New signings Georgi Hristov and Eric Tinkler will play while West Ham have a defensive crisis with captain Julian Dicks (knee) and Richard Hall (toe) out with long term injuries.
Other matches on Saturday see Everton host Crystal Palace with Italian striker Attilio Lombardo making his debut for the Premier League newcomers.

Aston Villa, with summer-signing Stan Collymore, travel across the midlands to play League Cup holders Leicester while the remaining fixture sees Southampton host last year's Division One champions Bolton.
